biggest_catch: The 'up to $760' figure is a ceiling that varies by center (Dallas/Houston/Meridian/Raleigh each post different totals) — and you must pass medical screening (not everyone qualifies) and donate repeatedly over weeks to earn it.
catches: The 'up to $760' figure is a ceiling tied to the Katy center's page; other centers post different totals (Dallas $710, Houston $630, Meridian $710, Raleigh $630), so compensation varies by location.
You must pass a medical history screening and physical exam before donating; not everyone qualifies.
Each donation visit takes significant time: Proesis' FAQ says the first donation takes approximately 2 hours and return visits average 60-90 minutes (90-150 minutes per visit range).
Earning the headline total requires completing up to 10 donations over several weeks (up to twice a week), not a single visit.
Payment rates can vary by location and change without notice; referral bonuses and special offers have their own separate conditions.

steps: Download and register with the ProesisPlus app and schedule your first appointment at a Proesis Bio center.
Attend your first visit: complete the medical history screening and physical exam to be approved as a donor.
Complete your first 10 donations (up to twice a week) to accrue the new-donor total, including standard, new-donor, and weekly bonuses.
Compensation is paid to the reloadable prepaid Visa debit card issued at your first donation.
timing: Compensation is paid to a reloadable prepaid Visa debit card issued at the first donation; the new-donor total accrues across the first 10 donations.
